Marta (partnerships): Quick flag — our new reseller listing (cloud marketplace) goes live next Tue. Partner expects a promo-driven 3x usage bump in week 1, then a 1.5x baseline uplift. Can infra quantify headroom?
Linus (eng-infra): Do we have their expected concurrency profile? 3x overall could be fine but burstiness matters.
Marta (partnerships): They gave daily GPU-hour estimates: baseline 12k GPU-hours/week -> expected 36k in promo week, fallback 18k/week after. They also mentioned lots of EU customers (eu-west1).
Samira (capacity-planning): OK noted. Need to run a sensitivity simulation: best-case (3x sustained), worst-case (4.5x sustained for 48h due to reseller promo stacking with our marketing). Also need region split: 65% EU, 30% NA, 5% APAC.
Priya (eng-platform): We should simulate impact on our reserved pools and Dedicated customers. If EU spots saturate, routing will fallback to NA/Dedicated which could blow up cross-region egress costs.
Alex (finance): Estimate both marginal GPU-hour cost and egress delta. Please provide a 72hr P50/P90 cost envelope so we can set partner credits threshold.
Linus (eng-infra): I'll run a cluster-level capacity sim. Quick checks: current available headroom (non-reserved) in eu-west1 = 420 A100-equivalent GPU-hours/day, reserved buffer = 1.2k GPU-hours/day.
Linus (eng-infra): Action: spinning up a sensitivity job. PromQL we use for utilization snapshot: "sum(rate(gpu_allocated_hours[1h])) by (region)". Will plug partner multipliers and attempt routing overflow logic.
DeployBot: job/sim-reseller-demand-1794 created by Linus — ETA 2h. Logs will land in #eng-infra/sim-logs.
Samira (capacity-planning): Also include KV-cache hit rate effect in simulation — longer chat sessions increase memory pressure and reduce throughput per GPU. Use conservative cache hit 30% vs nominal 50%.
Priya (eng-platform): Noted. Also run with our serving optimization toggles: batching aggressive vs conservative. Aggressive batching halves token cost but adds 40-60ms latency tail; partner SLA?
Marta (partnerships): Partner requires 95th latency < 600ms for chat flow. They prefer high quality, so don't swap to quantized model variants without telling them.
Linus (eng-infra): First pass results: with partner 3x and conservative cache (30%) eu-west1 hits 98% utilization peak; routing shifts ~22% to NA (reserved), adding estimated $2.8k/day in egress and cross-region infra. Worst-case 4.5x -> queuing starts and latencies exceed SLA.
Samira (capacity-planning): Can we carve out temporary burst pool in EU by converting some reserved Dedicated capacity to burst mode for 7 days? What's the ops cost/time?
Linus (eng-infra): Possible but requires contract change for Dedicated customers or using preemptible spot pool. Ops timeline ~6-8 hours to reconfigure autoscaler policies and pre-warm images. Spots are cheaper but risk of preemption affecting latency SLA.
Alex (finance): If we grant a one-week burst buffer, what's the marginal cost vs offering partner a promo credit? Compare: burst buffer cost est $18k for promo week; offering 30% partner credit (on billable tokens) est $12k. Which is cheaper net?
Priya (eng-platform): Also consider quality/regression risk if we route to different model variants. Recommend: 1) Offer partner a 20% credit and require rate limiting at 2x planned peak, 2) Prepare an EU burst pool (pre-warm) as contingency, 3) enable aggressive batching for non-interactive retries only.
Marta (partnerships): Partner will accept credit if we guarantee route-level throttles and a defined fallback. They want a post-mortem SLA if we miss.
Linus (eng-infra): Next steps: I will post full sim outputs (CSV + PromQL queries) in #eng-infra/sim-logs in ~2h. If P90 cost delta <= $15k we can do partner credit + soft burst. If > $15k recommend we require a minimum commitment / reserved capacity.
Samira (capacity-planning): I'll draft a short runbook for marketplace spikes: thresholds (GPU-hours/day), escalation (oncall infra -> capacity -> partnerships), and automated policy toggles (burst enable, model-variant disable).
Alex (finance): Please include a simple cost model: baseline vs promo week vs worst-case, with and without egress. Put numbers at P50/P90.
Marta (partnerships): Thanks — timeline: need final plan + partner-facing commitment by Friday EOD. Linus, Samira, Priya — can you confirm readiness? :thumbsup:
Linus (eng-infra): Confirmed, will share sims in 2h. :white_check_mark:
Priya (eng-platform): Confirmed, prepping autoscaler playbook. :thumbsup:
Samira (capacity-planning): Confirmed, drafting runbook now.
DeployBot: alert: sim-reseller-demand-1794 completed — results posted at https://internal/sim-logs/1794.csv
Linus (eng-infra): Uploaded CSV and a short notes file: includes P50/P90 cost envelopes, region-by-region utilization, and recommended temporary EU burst of 900 GPU-hours/day for 7 days to keep latency under SLA.
Marta (partnerships): Awesome — will negotiate 20% credit + min commitment adjustment. Thanks team.
